welcome-sub: Ọnụ ụzọ na-enye Africa ike site na Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Na emume ụbọchị Africa nke 25, ewepụtara ngwa ọzụzụ Pi Pioneers a)
intro: OKWU MMALITE — GỊNỊ BỤ PI NETWORK?
intro-p1: Pi Network bụ ego dijitalụ na ọrụ gburugburu ụwa emebere iji mee ka cryptocurrency nweta ma baara onye ọ bụla uru.
intro-p2: N'adịghị ka ego crypto ọdịnala na-achọ igwe igwe dị oke ọnụ, Pi Network na-enye ndị nkịtị ohere isonye ozugbo site na ekwentị ha.
intro-list:
• Wulite akụ na ụba dijitalụ gụnyere
  • Nye ndị nkịtị ike n'ụwa niile
  • Mụbaa ojiji ndụ n'ezie
  • Kwado azụmahịa mmadụ na mmadụ
ch1-p2: Kwụpụ 2: Debanye aha na Facebook ma ọ bụ Ekwentị → Tinye koodu: CHIGALEX1 → Nweta ụgwọ ọrụ 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ngwuputa Kwa Ụbọchị: Laghachi kwa awa 24 ọ bụla wee pịa bọtịnụ àmụmà ka ịga n'ihu na-egwuputa.
ch1-list:
• Mepụta obere akpa Pi na nchekwa
  • Mezue 2FA
  • Mezue KYC
  • Kwadebe maka mbugharị Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Nchekwa obere akpa: Ekekọrịtala okwu 24 passphrase gị! Ndị otu Pi Core agaghị ajụ gị!
ch2-p1: Obere akpa Pi gị bụ ụlọ akụ gị na Pi Ecosystem. Ọ na-ejide mkpụrụ ego Pi gị na nchekwa na blockchain.
ch2-p2: Otu esi emepụta: Mepee Pi Browser → Wallet → Mepụta Wallet → Detuo okwu 24 gị → Chekwaa na-anọghị n'ịntanetị na ebe 2 dị nchebe.
ch2-p3: Ịnata Pi: Kekọrịta adreesị ọha gị (na-amalite na G...). Izipu Pi: Tapawa adreesị nnata, tinye ego, gosi.
ch2a-p1: Bara uru: Malite na obere ego ule (1 Pi). Nyochaa mkpụrụedemede 4 mbụ na 4 ikpeazụ nke adreesị dakọtara. Edebanyela passphrase gị na webụsaịtị ọ bụla!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser dị ka Google Play Store maka Pi. DApps bụ ngwa enweghị isi maka ezigbo uru — ịzụ ahịa, agụmakwụkwọ, egwuregwu, ọrụ niile na-eji Pi.
ch4-p1: Chọpụta azụmaahịa na-anabata Pi n'ụwa niile na mapofpi.com. Debanye aha azụmahịa nke gị wee malite ịnabata Pi maka ngwaahịa na ọrụ.
ch5-p1: Uru Nkwekọrịta Ụwa (GCV) na-agba ume ezigbo ojiji. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Ndị ọsụ ụzọ na-eji Pi na azụmaahịa n'ezie na-ewulite uru a.
ch6-p1: Mụta akwụkwọ ntuziaka Doris Yin maka imepụta uru na uto gburugburu ebe obibi. Nyochaa, mụta, ma kuziere ndị ọzọ — otu a ka anyị si enye Africa ike.
final-msg: Africa nwere ohere ịbụ otu n'ime mpaghara kachasị ike na uru bara uru n'ime Pi Ecosystem. Ọnụ Anyị Na-ewu. Ọnụ Anyị Na-akụzi.
